home.taglineQuote: Where every kebab tells a story, and every bite feels like home.
home.heroSubtitle: A family tradition in the heart of Bjelovar
home.storyText: In 2015, a small family opened their doors on the streets of Bjelovar with one simple dream: to serve the best kebab in town. No shortcuts, no compromises. Fresh spit-roasted meat every single day, homemade sauces from recipes passed down through generations, and bread that crunches just right under your fingers. What started as a humble shop quickly became a gathering place - where friends meet, families celebrate, and strangers become regulars. City Kebab isn't just food. It's a piece of Bjelovar's heart.
home.storyText2: Today, City Kebab stands as a beloved landmark. The same passion, the same recipes, the same warmth that greeted the very first customer still lives in every order we prepare.
home.qualityBreadDesc: Baked fresh, crispy on the outside
home.qualityLoveDesc: Every kebab crafted by hand with care
home.review1Text: I've been coming here since they first opened. The kebab is always perfect - crispy bread, fresh meat, the sauce is unbelievable. This is THE place in Bjelovar.
home.review2Text: My whole office orders from City Kebab every Friday. It's our tradition now. The group ordering makes it so easy and the food never disappoints.
home.review3Text: I brought my friends from Zagreb here and they couldn't believe how good it was. Now they drive to Bjelovar just for the kebab!
home.review4Text: The vegetarian option is amazing too! They put so much care into everything. You can taste the love in every bite. Best fast food in the county.
